title: the math functions of Exudyn in a small namespace EM, used without it where a file calls many, and a check that refuses the library functions
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG4.1.3.6: EXUmath::Sin, ... become EM::Sin, ... (Exudyn math functions, the 14 functions only); a .cpp file with more than five calls says 'using namespace EM;' and calls Sin(...), the headers of basic math, kinematics and Lie groups keep EM::; tools/checkMathFunctions.py in exudev generate --all-checks refuses a call of sin, std::sin, ... in src/ outside the graphics and the tests
releaseNotes: the math functions of the C++ code are EM::Sin, ... - the namespace EM holds only these 14; a .cpp file with more than five calls uses them without it - and tools/checkMathFunctions.py, part of exudev generate --all-checks, refuses a call of the library's sin, std::sin, ... outside the graphics and the tests
